schemaNote: Progression 2.0 Phase 2 (Issue #190) discovery/unlock/economy design candidate. Docs/data only; NOT src/**, NOT the production Progression SSOT, NOT final prices or thresholds. Generated deterministically by tools/progression2_phase2_progression.py from the Phase-1 matrix and read-only production data. Every value here is a comparison candidate; the recommended one is labelled.

discoveryRule.matching: exact runtime-signature match of a PASS free-cooked pizza against every discoverable, undiscovered target
discoveryRule.observationRule: a dimension is observed only once its capability is unlocked; before that the default value is assumed, so a player can never miss a target because of a dimension they cannot yet control
discoveryRule.candidateOnlyEvidence: never part of identity (Phase-1 CANDIDATE strengths are excluded)
discoveryRule.extraIngredients: a superset of a target's ingredients is an ORIGINAL pizza, not a discovery (Teto may give a near-miss hint)

EVIDENCE_STRICT.labelJa: 証拠のみ（未決定の製品判断をすべて未解決のまま扱う）

SHIPPED_KEEP.labelJa: 出荷済みレシピの構成を維持（A-01/A-02 のオプション1を仮置き）

DOUGH_VARIANT.teach: 生地カードを選ぶだけ。既存の DOUGH ジェスチャーはそのまま。

MULTI_SPREAD_LAYER.teach: 2つめのソース/ドリズル。既存のソース塗りジェスチャーを再利用。

LATE_ADDITION.teach: 焼いた後（または途中）にのせる FINISH ステップ。

STEP_ORDER.teach: チーズを先に、ソースを後に。順番という概念だけ。

PAN_BAKE.teach: 焼き型（パン/天板）を選んで焼く。構造的変化。

PREP_STEP.teach: のせる前に炒める/水気を切る下ごしらえ。新しい操作。

ZONED_PLACEMENT.teach: 4分割などエリアごとに具材を置く。

DOUGH_SHAPE_TARGET.teach: 四角/舟形に生地を成形し、形に合わせてカット。

ENCLOSE.teach: 折る/2枚で挟む/重ねる。閉じた形はカットなし。

LAMINATE.teach: 生地そのものを折り込んで層にする。

M1_COVERAGE_GREEDY.labelJa: 解禁レシピ数だけで貪欲に選ぶ（Phase-1 の順序付けと同じ考え方）

M2_TUTORIAL_WEIGHTED.labelJa: 最初の12発見は材料だけ。以後、6発見ごとに「いま届く中で一番やさしい」Mechanic を1つ教える

M3_MECHANICS_LAST.labelJa: 材料だけで届くレシピを出し切ってから Mechanic を導入

G0_LEGACY_LADDER_10.labelJa: 旧案型: ⭐=Dex BEST★合計、解禁ごとに ⭐+10 の固定ラダー

G1_LEGACY_SUM_DERIVED_060.labelJa: ⭐=Dex BEST★合計、しきい値は到達可能数から導出（f=0.6）

G6_HYBRID_100.labelJa: Hybrid ⭐ f=1.0（到達可能なものを全部発見するまで次へ進めない）

PR_FLAT_120.labelJa: 全材料 120 Pitz（現行 onion 相当）

PR_IMPACT.labelJa: 50 + 25×その解禁で増える発見数（最大4）

S10_R10.labelJa: 購入時 10 回分、補充 +10 回分（価格×0.5）

S5_R5.labelJa: 購入時 5 回分、補充 +5 回分（価格×0.3）

S3_R5.labelJa: 購入時 3 回分、補充 +5 回分（価格×0.3）

FLOOR.labelJa: ★1 に下限 ×0.2 を追加（PASS した焼成は必ず Pitz>0）

FLOOR_DISCOVERY_BONUS.labelJa: FLOOR ＋ 新発見ボーナス +50 Pitz

WORST.labelJa: 常に★1（最低品質でも完成扱い）

COMPLETIONIST.labelJa: 到達可能なものは全部自力で見つける

HINTS_ON.labelJa: 新発見のない焼成が2回続いたら、テトが「いま作れるのに未発見」の1枚をほのめかす

designDecisions.question: shipped margherita {tomato-sauce, mozzarella, basil} vs PIZZA DB row (+olive-oil, needs MULTI_SPREAD_LAYER)
designDecisions.whyItBlocks: Under EVIDENCE_STRICT the three starter ingredients complete ZERO evidence-ready targets; the zero-recipe start has no first discovery without this decision.
options: adopt PIZZA DB composition and change the starter set (see alternativeFirstDiscoveries)
designDecisions.recommendation: keep shipped composition; PIZZA DB row stays a separate blocked candidate until MULTI_SPREAD_LAYER exists

designDecisions.topic: Shipped recipes without a 172 row, and shipped composition conflicts
designDecisions.question: Do the 14 shipped recipes (excluding corroborated tonno-e-cipolla) stay discoverable with their shipped compositions?
designDecisions.whyItBlocks: They are the densest early content (funghi, pepperoni, salsiccia...) and existing saves already contain them.
options: keep only the 5 that have no 172 row
designDecisions.recommendation: keep all 14 for Phase 3; resolve each PIZZA DB conflict row separately later

designDecisions.question: Replace totalStars = sum(Dex BEST) with a guaranteed-per-discovery star model?
designDecisions.whyItBlocks: With a one-recipe start the legacy ladder (⭐10/20/...) is unreachable; see simulation G0.

designDecisions.topic: Free-cook discovery instead of recipe selection
designDecisions.question: Discovery happens by exact runtime-signature match of a free-cooked pizza (no recipe picked first).
designDecisions.whyItBlocks: Current production is recipe-first (SELECT_RECIPE -> PREPARE); a zero-recipe start cannot begin there.
options: keep recipe-first and pre-grant margherita (contradicts zero-recipe start)

designDecisions.topic: Pitz floor for a PASS ★1 bake
designDecisions.question: Current reward table pays ×0 at ★1; a player who never exceeds ★1 can never buy anything.
designDecisions.whyItBlocks: Economic deadlock for the WORST skill model (simulation reward=LEGACY).

designDecisions.question: portions granted on purchase and per restock
Every evidenced non-standard dough variant and pan is one item here; merging would need evidence that it keeps all signatures unique.
Grandfather existing Dex/owned ingredients into Progression 2.0 or reset?
options: grandfather (discovered stays discovered; owned stays owned; ⭐ recomputed)

designDecisions.question: Only 62 catalog ingredients have a category; the rest need one before the tray can tab/filter them.

designDecisions.topic: Lunch Rush entry and order pool
designDecisions.question: Lunch Rush unlocks at the first discovery and draws only from discovered recipes with stock (never the all-orders fallback).

zeroRecipeStart.claim: The recommended start (0 discovered, starters tomato-sauce/mozzarella/basil) always has a discoverable target.

unlimitedIncomeRecipe.claim: After the first discovery at least one discovered target uses only unlimited starter items, so a PASS bake is always possible without stock or Pitz.

pitzNeverCircular.claim: Pitz income needs only that unlimited recipe; with the FLOOR reward every PASS bake pays > 0, so any finite price is reachable.

starsNeverCircular.claim: Each gate asks for at most ceil(f x previously-discoverable) guaranteed-star discoveries, so it is always met by targets that are already discoverable.

lunchRush.claim: Lunch Rush opens at the first discovery and draws orders only from discovered targets with stock; the unlimited Margherita keeps the pool non-empty.

allEvidenceReadyReachable.claim: Every evidence-ready target is reachable by the unlock schedule.
